title: Concept: Environment dump returned in a response
description: An environment listing with database URLs and secrets in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The environment carries database URLs, API keys and feature switches for the whole process, so a dump is usually the shortest path from a web bug to production access.
applicability: Deployments that render an environment listing with database URLs and secrets into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The environment carries database URLs, API keys and feature switches for the whole process, so a dump is usually the shortest path from a web bug to production access.
